target_customer: Enterprise real estate, workplace and facilities leaders
problem: Companies do not know how their offices are actually used, so they overpay for space and design poorly.
business_model: Sensor-as-a-service and analytics SaaS subscription per sensor or square foot
product_category: Workplace occupancy sensing and space analytics

founders.name: Dan Ryan
founders.background_notes: YC page and company about page name him as CEO and co-founder.

founders.name: Kelby Green
founders.background_notes: Named a co-founder on the YC page and the company about page (via search result). No bio found.

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom multi-sensor hardware with on-device machine learning, a cloud training platform and deployment in many buildings.

defensibility.rationale: Installed hardware and years of occupancy data raise switching costs, but rivals such as Density used different sensors.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: JLL Spark invested rather than competing; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: No dated 2017 source found; later COVID drove office occupancy demand per a 2020 funding article.

identity.voice_and_tone: Mission wording about connection, inspiration and sustainability, which one critical profile says reads like consultant copy

branding.brand_signature: Raise the Power of the Square Foot, the Series C tagline
branding.community_and_virality: Publishes an annual Workplace Occupancy and Utilization Index and a podcast.

brand_strength.rationale: Recognized in workplace tech with investor press, but no sourced evidence of viral or community pull.

pivots.to: Meridian space-planning software platform using multiple data sources
pivots.why: Not sourced; the current site describes planning that works without sensors

outcome_analysis: VergeSense went from a 1.5M seed in 2018 to a 60M Series C in 2021, helped by strategic investors JLL Spark and Allegion and by the shift to hybrid work. It claims over 200 enterprise customers and eight years of occupancy data, and moved to a software planning product called Meridian. It is active with no found acquisition or layoff.
notes: Seed investors and exact Series A date not confirmed by the cited articles; aggregators suggest JLL Spark led the seed and an Aug 2017 120K YC deal. Series B date is Dec 2020 (Verdantix, SiliconANGLE) versus Jan 2021 on one aggregator. CB Insights total is 82.62M over seven rounds, which fits the rounds recorded. The search for pre-batch competitors returned only 2026 comparison pages, so the competitor list is empty. Name origin not found.
